module_summary: Simple dual-port synchronous RAM: a register array written on write_en and a registered read port that outputs zero when read_en is low.

anchors.name: RAM
anchors.why: Memory array holding written data; indexed by write_addr and read_addr.

anchors.name: read_data
anchors.why: Registered read output, loaded from RAM[read_addr] or cleared when read disabled.

anchors.name: write_data
anchors.why: Write payload stored into the RAM array.

anchors.name: read_addr
anchors.why: Selects the RAM entry read into read_data.

anchors.name: write_en
anchors.why: Gates the write of write_data into RAM.

anchors.name: read_en
anchors.why: Gates loading read_data from RAM; otherwise output cleared.

groups.name: memory_array
groups.description: Register array with synchronous write port controlled by write_en.

groups.name: read_port
groups.description: Registered read of RAM at read_addr, zeroed when read_en low.
